address: 14926 S Pony Express Rd – Bluffdale Data Center | DataBank
14926 S Pony Express Rd - Bluffdale, UT 84065

reading.body:
DataBank SLC3 in Bluffdale, Utah publishes 7 MW of IT capacity across 55,780 square feet, making it a mid-tier colocation facility rather than a hyperscale AI training hub.

The floor area works out to roughly 8 square feet per kilowatt, which suggests a mixed-use colocation design. At standard colocation density of 10 kW per rack, this facility could hold about 700 racks. At the 40 kW per rack density common in AI training, the same power budget supports roughly 175 racks. The operator publishes no certifications, connectivity specs, or redundancy ratings, leaving compliance and infrastructure quality unstated.

Among Utah's 21 mapped data center facilities, only 3 publish capacity figures. Those three together account for 39 MW, making SLC3's 7 MW the third largest. This represents 18 percent of Utah's disclosed capacity, though the true statewide footprint is larger because most facilities publish no power data. For AI workload planning, 7 MW is sufficient for inference or smaller training runs but falls well below the scale of purpose-built hyperscale campuses that now support large model training. This facility illustrates the gap between colocation infrastructure and the dedicated power and building footprints that large-scale AI development now requires.
